name: 01-zen-garden
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: flat front cartridge sticker concept for Kakuro for the Game Boy.
Primary request: Create one polished sticker design with approximately 42:37 landscape aspect ratio, filling the image. Quiet Japanese zen garden illustration: raked sand curves around dark stones, subtle number-crossword grid woven into sand. Cream, navy and terracotta, in harmony with a retro handheld puzzle game.
Composition: straight-on flat printable artwork, rounded rectangular boundary, vertical platform strip on the left reading "GAME BOY"; main title very prominent.
Text (verbatim): "KAKURO", "NUMBER CROSSWORD", "LOGIC PUZZLE", "80 PUZZLES", "FRONT", "COLOR ENHANCED", "HOMEBREW".
Constraints: This is a number crossword logic puzzle with Game Boy and Game Boy Color support. Kakuro clue squares are bisected diagonally and playable squares contain digits 1–9. Keep text readable at sticker scale. No cartridge shell, no perspective, no staged scene, no watermark, no official licensing seals.
